step4.methodologyDisclaimer: A single run shows one possible trajectory, not a probability.
step4.methodologyMultiRunLimit: A multi-run shows how stable a trajectory is WITHIN the model – not how likely it is in the real world.

reliability.singleRunHint: A single run shows one possible path, not a forecast.
reliability.ensembleHint: These values show ranges from multiple runs – not real-world probabilities.
reliability.inMaterialHint: Already in your material – not a new insight.

ensemble.startHint: Compare several simulation runs across variants.
ensemble.variantNullPersonas: Single language model: with role profiles
ensemble.variantLabelNullPersonas: Single language model: with role profiles
ensemble.roundPaceHint: Longer rounds finish faster, but with less back-and-forth per day.
ensemble.summaryUnclear: There is no clear difference between the simulation and the comparison arms.
ensemble.summaryDiffers: The simulation and the comparison arms differ on this question.
ensemble.summaryMixed: The comparison arms do not all agree: only some show a clear difference.
ensemble.meaningBody: Every result figure is only the share of runs from this simulation setup, for example: 7 of 10 runs in this simulation. These values show ranges from multiple runs – not real-world probabilities.
ensemble.meaningLimit: Claims about the real world require comparison with real cases first. Progress figures only show how many runs have technically finished.
ensemble.cell: {yes} of {n} runs in this simulation · share: {rate}% · variation: {lo}–{hi}%
ensemble.cellNoRange: {yes} of {n} runs in this simulation · share: {rate}% · variation: —
ensemble.diffValue: difference between run shares: {value} percentage points
ensemble.diffCi: variation range for this difference: {low} to {high} percentage points
ensemble.exploratoryWarning: Additional observation – do not use as evidence (exploratory)
ensemble.pMcnemar: Chance check (McNemar p): {value} – smaller means less likely chance
ensemble.pHolm: Chance check, adjusted for many comparisons (Holm p): {value}
ensemble.mechanismUnavailable: This variant cannot technically produce this interaction. It is therefore not compared with the baseline for this mechanism.
ensemble.ciHelpTitle: What do the variation ranges mean? (Confidence intervals)
ensemble.ciHelpBody: The middle figure is the share of runs from this simulation setup in which the outcome appeared. The range next to it only describes variation within the model. It does not say how likely the outcome is in the real world.
ensemble.customQuestionsHint: Describe an event you can spot in the posts, e.g. ‘People call for a signature campaign’.
ensemble.customTooLong: Each question may be at most 200 characters.
ensemble.compareUnreliable: Raters disagree – do not interpret this figure
ensemble.reliabilityUnmeasurableHint: Raters disagree – do not interpret this figure
ensemble.reliabilityKappaHelp: This agreement score (kappa) measures how often raters agree on this outcome. Near 1 = agreement, near 0 = pure chance.
ensemble.cancelText: Running variants will be stopped. Partial results so far are kept.
ensemble.deleteText: This multi-run and its results will be removed.
